g.text: Only 11 of 26 matched students have recorded usage.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: Personal tracking begins 8 Sep 2026, 13:49 Beijing time.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: Main cutoff: 16 Sep, 08:00 Beijing; exam begins at 12:00.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: No recorded usage does not mean no learning or resource access.
